title: MultiParaDetox: Extending Text Detoxification with Parallel Data to New Languages
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of text detoxification (paraphrasing toxic text to a neutral style). It does not involve benchmarking or evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics. A section on 'Ethical Considerations' is present but discusses research impact and crowdsourcing practices rather than evaluating moral or ethical reasoning.
